systems.system: Bill on classification, circulation and availability of information

EGY.note: The document describes a bill on classification and circulation of information between state sectors; it does not say it gives a person a right to ask public bodies for information.
The document mentions the national digital transformation strategy only in passing; it states nothing on its standing, text, period, plan or reporting.

facts.fact: House ICT committee chair Ahmed Badawi told Al-Dostor the government has finished preparing a 35-article bill on classifying, circulating and making available information, which governs data exchange between the state's executive sectors (classified information excluded) and is due to go to parliament at the start of the next session.
